fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, reloading one {{as|shell|buzzword3}} while generating a {{tip|stack}} of ''True Grit'' for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times. Dashing towards an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates 2 stacks of ''True Grit''.
fields.description2: ''Quickdraw's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds for every {{as|pellet|buzzword2}} impacting an enemy.
fields.description3: {{sbc|True Grit:}} For each stack, '''Graves''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} equal to 50% of that amount. Subsequent casts of ''Quickdraw'' and damage versus non-{{tip|minions}} will refresh the duration of ''True Grit''.
